# Framed by Santi

> Street photography from New York by Santi García, shot on a Fujifilm X100VI. The site shows his photo sets, grouped by theme, and a short page about him.

The site is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Each photo set has its own page with every photo of the set, its description and its theme.

## Pages

- [Home](https://framed-by-santi.vercel.app/): Introduction to Santi and his latest photo sets
- [Gallery](https://framed-by-santi.vercel.app/gallery): All published photo sets, filterable by theme
- [About](https://framed-by-santi.vercel.app/about): Who Santi is, his city and his camera

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/framedbysanti/): More of Santi's photos, posted as he takes them
